subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) His friend thought that, the contents of the parcel were valuable. (b) The letter contained nothing but some words. (c) To his utter surprise he found nothing but an ordinary stone. (d) During stay in Italy, an English poet had to pay double postage for an unpaid letter from his friend. (e) He sent a heavy stone packed in a fine box with the words on it, “Carriage to be paid on delivers. (f) Being annoyed lie wanted to teach his friend a good lesson. (g) With a great hope he opened the box after paying the heavy charge for carrying. (h) Thus the poet taught his friend a good lesson.
guide_solution: d → b → f → e → a → g → c → h
